description: This file defines a class 'Env' that provides access to environment variables used for configuration purposes in a Flutter project. It reads environment variables via the flutter_dotenv package and offers default values if the variables are not set.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class that provides static getters to access environment variables related to API configuration, feature flags, and remote connectivity.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL of the backend API, defaulting to 'http://localhost:8080' if not set.

methods.name: useRemote
methods.description: Determines whether to use remote API integration based on the 'USE_REMOTE' environment variable, defaulting to true.

methods.name: featureRealtime
methods.description: Checks if the realtime feature flag ('FEATURE_FLAG_REALTIME') is enabled, defaulting to false.
